'''The Viper Flicks Its Tongue''' is a [[sword form]]. It can be used when a swordsman fights alone, but it is more effective when used with an ally. [[Sleete]] used this form when he and [[Marlesh]] practiced against [[Gawyn Trakand]] in the village of [[Dorlan]]. Gawyn countered with [[Cat Dances on the Wall]].{{ref/book|12|13}}
